# MacMillan Studio

> Independent tech lead and creative developer. Over a decade of experience implementing fully custom, high-quality interactive experiences for global agencies and brands.

Christian MacMillan is an independent developer and tech lead based between Barcelona and remote engagements worldwide. The studio partners with agencies, in-house teams, and direct clients to design and build interactive websites, WebGL experiences, product interfaces, and creative tooling.

Core capabilities:
- Interactive websites and product UIs (Nuxt, Vue, Next.js, React, TypeScript)
- WebGL and real-time graphics (Three.js, custom shaders, GLSL)
- Animation and motion (GSAP, custom timelines, scroll-driven experiences)
- Creative technology R&D and prototyping
- Tech leadership, architecture, and code review for creative engineering teams
